## Notes

  - KG = ontology + data. The ontology is a means, not a goal.
  - This is socio-technical work.
  - Use incentives to improve data quality, e.g. a company tying a 20% bonus to data quality.
  - See <https://www.knowledgescientist.org/> (with Paul Groth), which clarifies how the knowledge scientist differs from the ontologist.
  - Governance is like the brakes on a car.
  - Your first KG is your metadata.
  - He mentioned that the PDF of his book *Designing and Building Enterprise Knowledge Graphs* (2021) is available for free.
  - See ISWC 2019: the pay-as-you-go methodology.

## What I take away

 - For future research: this is socio-technical work.

## Open questions

- Will LLMs win?
